idea: Use tilted equal-square packings as sub-blocks. Precompute, by penalty optimisation, small near-optimal rotated packings of m equal squares in a square container (Friedman-type, e.g. m=5, 10, 11). Treat each as a substitutable block with its (count, scaled sum) in the substitution and partition recurrences, so rotated structures can appear inside otherwise axis-aligned layouts.
